input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties, kill fees or minimum/early-termination charges on Clear Capital. Termination for convenience (§ 6(a)) requires only fifteen days' notice with no exit payment, and termination for breach (§ 6(b)) limits our exposure to fees and expenses actually incurred or earned through the termination date. Compensation in § 3 is pure time-and-materials with no minimum commitment, and searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "minimum", "cancel" and late-payment interest return nothing. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is needed.
